programs.title: Penguins: Meet the Family
programs.desc: The penguin family includes as many as eighteen colorful species.Although the lush forests of New Zealand are not associated with these animals, this is where the penguin family evolved sixty million years ago and where most of its species live.One of the most interesting penguins is the great crested penguin, which loves bathing in spas.In turn, the African penguin has adapted to life in the city, which is why we can meet him walking among people on the streets of Cape Town.The Galapagos penguin managed to adapt to life in the hot equatorial climate.Penguins stand out for their parenting skills.Some species, such as white-eyed penguins, can travel long kilometers to find a suitable place to nest.Other species are clever - to repair their nests after winter, they steal stones from their neighbors' nests.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: Jimmy Doherty's New Zealand Escape
programs.desc: Jimmy takes a trip to the tropical north to visit New Zealand.His culinary discoveries will not be the only attraction of the program.There will also be a visit to the winery and a show of seasonal specialties.

programs.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programs.desc: Everyday objects are prosaic companions of our everyday life and we rarely think about how they were created.However, they often hide fascinating stories.
